name: TOCALO Co.,Ltd.
summary: TOCALO Co.,Ltd. develops surface modifying technologies in Japan, China, Taiwan, the United States, and internationally. It produces functional coatings through thermal spraying technology, including vacuum and atmospheric plasma, electric arc, high velocity oxy-fuel spraying, suspension plasma spraying, and SDC thick coatings, as well as powder, rod, and wire flame spraying processes for semiconductor and flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment components, industrial machinery parts, steel rolls, paper rolls, and chemical plant parts.
